summary: fix(settings): point PairConnectHint help link to the no-QR article
description:
Because:

* "Learn more" on the connect hint page should open the article about
  connecting a device without a QR code, not the generic sync setup page.

This commit:

* Adds PAIR_WITHOUT_QR_SUPPORT_URL, the in-product SUMO link with the
  %VERSION%, %OS% and %LOCALE% placeholders.
* Points the PairConnectHint link and its test at it.

Closes #FXA-14603
